does: Starts the server inside the game's process: makes esv::GameServer (arguments 8, 0x1A, 10000) and initialises it, sets the HUB's player info, makes the item combination and cast requirement managers from ls::ImmutableDataHeadmaster and eoc::SpellPrototypeManager (data the process's module load made), and the mod settings from eoc::ServerInit.

evidence.says: EoCServer.dll+0x2A1BC0 exports it; its body read.
The macOS build's symbols hold this name; nothing but the name ties it to this function

questions.ask: Whether StartUp can run with no local client (a dedicated mode): its managers read the process's shared module data, which the client's LoadModule loads.
